title: Minimum Factorization
description: Given a positive integer num, return *the smallest positive integer *`x`* whose multiplication of each digit equals *`num`. If there is no answer or the answer is not fit in **32-bit** signed integer, return `0`.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Minimum Factorization.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
